reason: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb (patch lines 67-81), a same-host match returns `website_host + URI(website).path`, so `http://example.com/` renders as `example.com/`. `URI#host` leaves out the port, so `example.com:8080/u` shows as `example.com/u`; the removed JS `websiteName` (`website.split("/")[2]`, controllers/user.js.es6:9-13) kept the port.
